sections.label: Center
sections.description: Sweet Spot / Our Pick. Center gives you the straightest look at the stage and the best balance for taking in the choreography, costumes and full production picture.

sections.label: Side
sections.description: The Side sections keep you close to the front half of the room with an angled look across the stage. You still see the production clearly, just from off-center.

sections.label: Rear
sections.description: Rear sits farther back and gives you the widest overall look at the stage. It is the easy choice when you care more about the full production picture than being close.
